item.title: Boeing knew of flaw in part linked to UPS plane crash, NTSB report says
item.description:
📝 It points out that Boeing had previously found failures of the same part on four occasions, affecting three different aircraft. In this case, Boeing recommended that the part be included in a general visual inspection every five years. "It's extraordinary that Boeing concluded that a failure of this part would not have safety consequences," he claimed.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cly56w0p9e1o

item.title: San Francisco to offer free childcare to people making up to $230k
item.description:
📝 Photograph: Stephen Lam/San Francisco Chronicle via Getty ImagesSan Francisco to make childcare free for families earning up to $230,000Officials to offer 50% subsidy up to $310,000 in effort to make one of world’s most expensive cities more affordableSan Francisco will offer free childcare to families earning less than $230,000 a year, and a 50% subsidy to those earning up to $310,000, in an expansion of the city’s childcare offerings designed to make one of the world’s most expensive cities more affordable for residents. Previously, free childcare was available to families earning less than 110% of the area median income. Families will be able to access free or reduced-cost childcare from more than 500 providers citywide.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jan/15/san-francisco-childcare-families
